text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Commission in charge of social dialogue holds first meeting in attempt to meet workers' demands.
- Human Rights Minister Abderrahman Amalou meets representative of United Nations children's fund (UNICEF) Sergio Soro to reinforce cooperation over children's rights.
- Chambers of Commerce of Casablanca and Johannesburg sign cooperation accord.
- Morocco to launch economic motorcycle priced at 4,950 dirhams ($569).
- Kuwait's ruler Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmed al-Sabah sends envoy to King Hassan to brief him over latest developments in Middle East.
